_comment: DERIVED, not verbatim. Section 6.2 of SP 800-140D cut into rows by ../schema/build.derived.py: one object per citation, each with source_lines and the quote written from them. Every row validates against ../schema/ApprovedSspMethodReference.derived.schema.json and the 6.2.2 rows are numbered 1 to 12 in order. The requirements lane owns these rows as requirements; this file is their machine form.
